name: error-reporting
body: Validation is fail-fast: exactly one error is reported (the first found). It states file, line if known, full path, what is wrong and how to fix it. The file part of the location follows native-display-paths: it is the file's path spelled as the user's own OS spells paths — the OS separator only, never mixed, and each directory's long name — and for a slide it is the slide's deck-relative path (e.g. `slides/3-team.md`), never an absolute path. On macOS and Linux the example error reads `slides/3-team.md:12 › column[1] › people[0] › name: required — add a name: value`; the same error on Windows reads `slides\3-team.md:12 › column[1] › people[0] › name: required — add a name: value`. Same text in terminal and browser error page. The same path form extends to nested section instances (e.g. `columns[2] › blocks[1]`, nested-section-validation), so the notation is uniform at any containment depth.
